name: Terre Haute (United States)
description: Navy blue field with a yellow cross fimbriated in white, charged at the centre with a yellow disc bearing a white sycamore leaf within a ring of white stars.
history: Terre Haute is a city in Vigo County, Indiana, and its county seat. The flag was adopted on 13 May 1976 (adopted by General Ordinance No. 22 of 13 May 1976 after a contest for the United States Bicentennial, according to Flags of the World; the same source notes that the design was apparently never manufactured, only a seal flag being made).

features.role: disc with a white sycamore leaf and a ring of stars
